content:
carmen: quick thread — we need to decide prioritization approach for the next inference perf epics. customer asks + infra cost pressure coming in. thoughts?

raj: for context — ACME and BetaCorp both flagged latency regressions on gen-heavy flows. ACME will only move to Dedicated if p99 drops < 300ms. BetaCorp cares about cost per 1M tokens more than p99.

olivia: sounds like conflicting signals. suggest we map by customer SLO + revenue risk then apply a RICE-like filter. low-effort batching/kv-cache changes could buy time. :thinking: 

ethan: agree on quick wins first. batching + prefix cache = small infra changes, high impact for chat-heavy customers. quantization/compilation work is bigger but lowers cost.

maya: can we write quick acceptance criteria so eng knows when to stop? e.g., canary must show p95 < 200ms on chat profile and <15% cost uplift for host customers, else revert.

carmen: +1 on acceptance criteria. proposing: 1) Short-term: enable adaptive batching + prefix KV cache rollout 2) Medium: kernel selection / compilation improvements 3) Long: lower-bit quantization + model variant routing for cost savings

raj: to help prioritize, I did a tiny RICE sketch. numbers are rough but directionally useful. paste below: 

```
features = [
  {"name": "adaptive_batching", "reach": "high", "impact": "medium", "confidence": "0.8", "effort": "2"},
  {"name": "prefix_kv_cache", "reach": "medium", "impact": "high", "confidence": "0.7", "effort": "3"},
  {"name": "kernel_select", "reach": "high", "impact": "medium", "confidence": "0.6", "effort": "5"},
  {"name": "quant_8bit", "reach": "high", "impact": "high", "confidence": "0.5", "effort": "8"}
]
# RICE proxy: (reach_score * impact_score * confidence) / effort
```

olivia: that helps. if we convert to numbers (reach 3,2,5 etc) we can get ranking. But also include sequencing constraints: batching must land before kernel_select to measure kernel impact properly.

ethan: ops note — prefix_kv_cache needs a small infra change: shard-level eviction + metrics. ops-bot can run a canary once we have feature flag.

ops-bot: canary checklist: feature-flag, telemetry (p50/p95/p99, cost per token), rollout policy, quick rollback path.

maya: important product constraint: we can't change default model routing for hosted customers without a migration path. any cost-saving routing must be opt-in for first 3 months.

carmen: decision proposal: do adaptive_batching + prefix_kv_cache in next sprint (2-week), set canary with criteria: p95 < 200ms for chat-heavy sims, cost per token not worse than current by >10% at p95 load. If green, move kernel_select in following sprint. Quantization flagged as Q3 initiative with dedicated infra sign-off.

raj: vote? +1 for that sequencing. RICE numbers still favor batching/cache first.

olivia: +1. I'll update the spec and add the canary criteria.

ethan: +1. eng-runbook stub coming.

maya: +1 on sequencing and opt-in routing constraint. will notify customer success to set expectations with ACME/BetaCorp.

carmen: thanks all. olivia — can you drop the spec link here when ready? we'll call this the decision record. :thumbsup: 

olivia: will do today. posting spec in #product-docs once done.
